calls.statement:
SELECT product_key, sku, product_name, valid_from, valid_to
FROM dim_product
WHERE subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND valid_from <= '2026-08-02' AND valid_to >= '2026-06-29'
ORDER BY product_key
LIMIT 20

SELECT COUNT(*) as product_count
FROM dim_product
WHERE subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND valid_from <= '2026-08-02' AND valid_to >= '2026-06-29'

SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) as total_units_sold,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  MIN(f.sale_date) as first_sale_date,
  MAX(f.sale_date) as last_sale_date
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE s.store_id = 108
  AND f.sale_date >= '2026-06-29' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-02'
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  p.category,
  p.subcategory,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_date) as sale_days
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE s.store_id = 108
  AND f.sale_date >= '2026-06-29' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-02'
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, p.category, p.subcategory

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar fc ON f.sale_date >= fc.period_start_date AND f.sale_date <= fc.period_end_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108
  AND fc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fc.fiscal_period = 3
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
